recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. Any future desire to add PV1-4 as an Encounter.type source should be handled by a new explicit core work-group decision because it would reverse the specific FHIR-7854 outcome.
issue_request: FHIR-7854 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Encounter change request from Patient Administration asking to change Encounter.type from PV1-4 Admission Type to PV1-18 Patient Type, because PV1-4 describes admission circumstances and Encounter.priority already maps to PV2-25.
initial_application: Commit 2afe9fbe29 applied the tracker by changing the old Encounter spreadsheet mapping from PV1-4-admission type to PV1-18 Patient Type. A later broad QA commit, 5f27be6a8d, changed that mapping to PV1-4 / PV1-18, and the current StructureDefinition inherited that value through the later source refactor.
additional_context: Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml is in current build scope. FHIR-5699 is a related Encounter v2 mapping issue but did not request an Encounter.type change. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches did not find a later core decision reversing FHIR-7854.
reconciliation: Changed source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml so Encounter.type maps to PV1-18 only, preserving the current field-number-only style used by nearby v2 mappings.
source_changes: source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml: changed Encounter.type HL7 v2 mapping from PV1-4 / PV1-18 to PV1-18.

related_jiras.note: Published Encounter v2 mapping update checked because it touched the same mapping family; its requested changes did not include Encounter.type.
Later Da Vinci Alerts issue comments mention PV1-4 and PV1-18 availability in ADT data, but it is an IG issue and does not alter the core Encounter mapping.
